theme: Protect income. Care for home. Build our way forward.
northStar: Keep the next few days obvious, the next couple of weeks easy to scan, and the longer direction available without making it dominate daily life.
workNorthStar: Protect dependable income while replacing lower-leverage hours with better work and repeatable 3DVR revenue, without letting the business consume home and family life.
operatingRule: Today first. Then the next few days. Protect recovery and home time before filling open space with more work.
workOperatingRule: Protect booked income, use open blocks for the highest-leverage work, and keep home/family commitments visible as real commitments.

today.title: Morning work
today.sharedDetail: Work through noon, then shift toward home/family time and getting ready for the protected Mexico-house block tomorrow.
today.detail: Protect the morning shift. After noon, keep business work minimal and prepare for the protected home block.

nextDays.title: Mexico house
nextDays.sharedDetail: Protected household and family time. Handle the important house needs without turning the whole block into chores.
nextDays.detail: Keep outside work minimal; prioritize the house, family time, and recovery before the dense work run.

nextDays.title: Mexico house + personal appointment
nextDays.sharedDetail: Keep the protected home block intact around one personal appointment. Leave real room for family, rest, and the important maintenance.
nextDays.detail: Avoid turning the open day into a remote workday; the home block remains the main commitment.

nextDays.title: Mexico house / return
nextDays.sharedDetail: Finish the house block and return with enough buffer to reset before four consecutive work days.
nextDays.detail: Protect the reset buffer; avoid unnecessary business pushes before Wednesday's work run.

calendar.title: Work day + family event
calendar.when: 7 AM–5 PM work · family event afterward

next30.title: Protect the home-to-work transition
next30.label: Sep 20–26
next30.sharedDetail: The Mexico-house block runs directly into four consecutive work days. Keep Tuesday's return/reset buffer intact and expect lower spare energy through Saturday.
next30.detail: Do not schedule unnecessary business pushes during the protected home block or four-day work run; let automation and asynchronous work carry routine activity.

next30.title: Resolve one calendar collision
next30.label: Sep 25
next30.sharedDetail: A personal appointment currently overlaps a booked work day. This needs to be reconciled before Friday the 25th so the week stays predictable.
next30.detail: Confirm whether the work schedule can accommodate the personal appointment or whether one commitment needs adjustment.

next30.title: Protect recovery after the work run
next30.label: Sep 27 → early Oct
next30.sharedDetail: After the dense work run and family event, several days are open before the next booked work day. Keep some of that opening for recovery and family instead of automatically filling it.
next30.detail: Balance recovery and home time with better-work hunting, active paid work, and one bounded 3DVR reliability push.

next30.title: Make income less fragile
next30.label: By mid-Oct
next30.sharedDetail: Keep dependable work while building at least one more repeatable source of income.
next30.detail: Pursue another paying client or recurring opportunity and higher-value freelance work.

next90.title: More control over the schedule
next90.label: October
next90.sharedDetail: Create fewer chaotic weeks and more choice over which work Thomas says yes to.
next90.detail: Replace weaker work selectively while keeping the financial floor intact.

next90.title: More predictable independent income
next90.label: November–December
next90.sharedDetail: Shift some income toward recurring work so every month does not start from zero.
next90.detail: Scale the service/channel that actually produces legitimate revenue with low support burden.
